items.raw_excerpt: The world’s tallest totem pole was brought down this week in Alert Bay, B.C., a community off the coast of northeast Vancouver Island. For two 'Na̱mǥis chiefs, the pole — recognized in the Guinness Book of World Records — represented much more than its height.
items.summary_en: The world's tallest totem pole was brought down this week in Alert Bay, British Columbia. It stood for more than 50 years and was listed in the Guinness Book of World Records. For two Namgis chiefs, the pole meant much more than its height.
items.summary_ko: 캐나다 브리티시컬럼비아주 알러트 베이에서 세계에서 가장 높은 토템폴이 이번 주에 내려졌다. 이 토템폴은 50년 넘게 서 있었고 기네스북에 등재되기도 했다. 지역 원주민 추장 두 명에게 이 토템폴은 단순한 높이 그 이상을 의미했다.

items.raw_excerpt: The Festival F will return to the historic centre of Faro, between 2 and 4 September 2027, reaffirming its commitment to Portuguese music and Lusophony.
items.summary_en: Festival F will take place in the historic centre of Faro, Portugal from September 2 to 4, 2027. The music festival celebrates Portuguese songs and Lusophone culture. Organizers say it will continue to promote local and regional musical talent.

items.summary_en: Brazilian writer Itamar Vieira Junior will be the guest on the radio show Conversa com o Autor on Rádio MEC. The talk will last about 30 minutes. They will discuss new releases, curiosities, his creative process, and book suggestions.

items.raw_excerpt: The composer of legendary Swedish pop group Abba on Sunday gave the band's hit "Mamma Mia" a campaign makeover to rally support for centre-left opposition candidate Magdalena Andersson.
items.summary_en: Benny Andersson, a composer from the famous Swedish pop group Abba, changed the lyrics of the hit song Mamma Mia. He sang it on Sunday to support Magdalena Andersson, a centre-left candidate for prime minister. The song became a campaign message.

items.raw_excerpt: For thousands of years, woolly dogs played an integral role in the lives of Salish and Makah peoples, who bred them and used their silky white fur for weaving. But the beloved animals were driven to extinction under colonialism in the late 1800s.
items.summary_en: For thousands of years, woolly dogs were special to the Salish and Makah people. Their silky white fur was used for weaving. Now the only known pelt has come back to Canada, a powerful moment for Indigenous communities.
items.summary_ko: 털복숭이개는 수천 년 동안 샐리시와 마카족에게 특별한 동물이었고, 부드러운 흰 털은 베 짜기에 쓰였습니다. 그러나 1800년대 후반 식민 통치 아래 이 개들은 멸종했습니다. 이제 유일하게 남은 가죽이 캐나다로 돌아와 원주민 공동체에게 뜻깊은 순간이 되었습니다.
items.title_en: A 160-year-old woolly dog pelt returns to Canada
items.title_ko: 멸종한 털복숭이개의 유일한 가죽, 캐나다로 돌아와
items.title_original: The only known woolly dog pelt has returned to Canada. It's a 'powerful moment' for Indigenous communities

items.raw_excerpt: Motorists on OMR express concerns over jaywalking and poor lighting, making nighttime driving hazardous.
items.summary_en: Drivers on the OMR expressway in Chennai say jaywalking and poor street lighting make night driving dangerous. They are asking for better lighting and safer crossings. The issue is a daily concern for local commuters.

items.raw_excerpt: People learning te reo Māori should not let the fear of getting it wrong stop them from using the language, Māori Language Commission chair Professor Rawinia Higgins says.
items.summary_en: People learning te reo Māori should not let the fear of getting it wrong stop them from using the language. Māori Language Commission chair Professor Rawinia Higgins says learners should just give it a go. Her message comes during Te Wiki o te Reo Māori, Māori Language Week.

items.title_original: Te Wiki o te Reo Māori: Don't let fear of getting it wrong stop you using te reo

items.raw_excerpt: Nova Scotia has an RSV vaccination program that provides free vaccines to three groups of people, but it leaves some seniors and immunocompromised people out. Paying out of pocket for the vaccine costs a few hundred dollars.
items.summary_en: Nova Scotia gives free RSV vaccines to three groups of people. But some seniors and people with weak immune systems are not included. They would have to pay a few hundred dollars to get the vaccine on their own.

items.title_en: Nova Scotia's RSV vaccine program leaves out some at-risk adults

items.raw_excerpt: Walking around the downtowns of New England's small towns is a great way to experience community, culture, and simply have a good time.
items.summary_en: Walking around the center of small New England towns is a great way to enjoy local life and culture. These towns are easy to explore on foot. Visitors can enjoy shops, parks, and simple good times.
